lines.3: 「Never mind. Your face tells me pretty much everything.」
lines.5: 「Left him there. He was in the way.」
lines.7: 「That woman said she wants to see you, so go meet her after school.」
lines.9: 「I've got a bad feeling about it, so I'm not going.」
lines.10: 「She'll probably just lecture you, but anyway, I passed the message on.」
lines.12: Then again, we were the ones who had raised her that way.
